title: Bold type posters
subtitle: Let one idea carry the whole key visual
heading: Bold type poster prompts: let one idea carry the whole key visual
seoTitle: Bold Type Campaign Poster Prompts: Oversized Type, Material, CMYK and Showa | Image Prompt Book
lead: None of these four need a reference image. Each one is a giant headline plus one strong subject. They differ in how type and subject meet: type sits behind, the subject cuts through the letters, the title blurs into texture, or the words become a slogan.

behind.title: Type sits behind; the subject sits in front

texture.title: Type becomes part of the surface

slogan.title: The words are a slogan; the subject is a character

campaign-poster-oversized-type.why: One large subject plus one “anomaly”, a wall of oversized type behind them and a high-contrast flat color. This is the most general starting point in the set.
campaign-poster-oversized-type.goodFor: Turning one line or one selling point into a 9:16 social key visual
campaign-poster-oversized-type.notFor: A poster that needs several paragraphs or a complex type hierarchy
campaign-poster-oversized-type.adjust: Anomaly, background and material; write the title and idea at the start of the prompt

material-type-campaign-poster.why: Only three things: a close-up of a real material, a flat color field, and a giant white condensed title the subject weaves through.
material-type-campaign-poster.goodFor: Brand, fabric or food pictures that have to show texture
material-type-campaign-poster.notFor: A picture that needs a person or a scene to tell a story
material-type-campaign-poster.adjust: Four brief presets, or fill in the title, subject, lens and colors yourself

cmyk-halftone-blur-type-poster.why: The subject is rebuilt in CMYK halftone. The giant title is softly out of focus; only the tiny black type is sharp. It reads more like experimental print.
cmyk-halftone-blur-type-poster.goodFor: An event, exhibition or show poster that can live with a title that is not fully readable
cmyk-halftone-blur-type-poster.notFor: Paid placement where the headline has to be read at a glance
cmyk-halftone-blur-type-poster.adjust: Four brief presets, or fill in the title, support copy, subject and layout yourself

showa-absurd-character-poster.why: A character is dropped into a giant, stuck or floating moment, then framed as a Showa tokusatsu poster. The huge title does the shouting.
showa-absurd-character-poster.goodFor: A character, IP or meme-style publicity poster
showa-absurd-character-poster.notFor: A restrained, high-end brand key visual
showa-absurd-character-poster.adjust: Character: four options, or replace it; plus a signature

choose: If this is your first bold-type poster, start with the oversized campaign poster. The structure is the most complete, and three option groups change the picture clearly.
If the subject is a material rather than an object, switch to material and giant type. If you want the title to recede into texture and look more experimental, use the CMYK halftone blur.
If the lead is a character and you want humor, use the Showa absurd character poster.
caution: Giant generated titles often have wrong or broken characters. Check the type before you publish. If needed, generate only the picture and set the title later.
